title: Virgin Trains a step closer to running services to Europe in blow to Eurostar

paragraphs.en: Virgin Trains has been granted track access by the rail regulator to enable it to run services between London and Paris, Brussels and Amsterdam from 2030, in a key step towards breaking Eurostar’s monopoly on the cross-Channel passenger route.
paragraphs.zh: 铁路监管机构已批准维珍火车（Virgin Trains）获得线路使用权，使其能够从2030年起运营往返伦敦与巴黎、布鲁塞尔和阿姆斯特丹的服务，这是打破欧洲之星（Eurostar）在跨海峡客运线路垄断的关键一步。

paragraphs.en: The Office of Rail and Road (ORR) said it had given approval for Richard Branson’s company to run as many as 20 daily return services using the High Speed 1 line that runs between London St Pancras and the Channel tunnel.
paragraphs.zh: 英国铁路与公路办公室（ORR）表示，已批准理查德·布兰森（Richard Branson）的公司使用连接伦敦圣潘克拉斯站（St Pancras）与英吉利海峡隧道的1号高速线（High Speed 1），每天运营多达20趟往返服务。

paragraphs.en: The agreement for the period between 1 October 2030 to 31 December 2040 means Virgin Trains has passed another important regulatory hurdle in its efforts to start international services. It only covers the HS1 route, however, and Virgin still needs to secure access to the tunnel and rail networks in mainland Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 这一协议的有效期为2030年10月1日至2040年12月31日，意味着维珍火车在启动国际服务的努力中又通过了一个重要的监管关口。不过，它只涵盖HS1线路，维珍仍需获得使用隧道和欧洲大陆铁路网络的权限。

paragraphs.en: Related: London-Berlin: competition hots up for cross-Channel rail links
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：伦敦-柏林：跨海峡铁路连接竞争升温

paragraphs.en: Last October Virgin was granted access to share Eurostar’s Temple Mills depot in east London to maintain and store trains, the only depot that can be accessed from HS1.
paragraphs.zh: 去年10月，维珍获得许可，可共用欧洲之星位于东伦敦的圣殿磨坊（Temple Mills）车辆段，用于列车的维护和停放，这是可从HS1线路进入的唯一车辆段。

paragraphs.en: Eurostar, which was formerly part-owned by the UK taxpayer but is now controlled by the French rail operator SNCF, has held a monopoly on passenger services through the tunnel since it opened in 1994. Eurotunnel, operator of LeShuttle, takes vehicles on the cross-Channel route.
paragraphs.zh: 欧洲之星此前部分由英国纳税人持股，但现在由法国铁路运营商法国国家铁路公司（SNCF）控股，自1994年隧道开通以来一直垄断着通过隧道的客运服务。运营LeShuttle的欧洲隧道公司（Eurotunnel）则负责跨海峡线路的车辆运输。

paragraphs.en: Eurostar has previously faced criticism over its high prices , and has shrunk its network over the past decade , ditching international services from Ashford and Ebbsfleet in Kent.
paragraphs.zh: 欧洲之星此前因票价高昂而受到批评，并在过去十年间收缩了其网络，取消了肯特郡阿什福德（Ashford）和埃布斯弗利特（Ebbsfleet）的国际服务。

paragraphs.en: Branson has previously said it was “time to end this 30-year monopoly and bring some Virgin magic to the cross-Channel route”.
paragraphs.zh: 布兰森此前曾表示，“是时候结束这30年的垄断，给跨海峡线路带来一些维珍的魔力了”。
